description:
Onimusha: Way of the Sword, the all new entry in Capcom's swordplay action series, releases on Friday, September 4, 2026!
Become the Onimusha, Miyamoto Musashi, and prepare yourself for the intense duels that await!

https://www.xbox.com/games/store/onimusha-way-of-the-sword/9pjmhtrc9wkb

Demo available now!
Experience the exhilarating swordplay action and earn yourself the save data bonus!

- Footage represents a game still in development.
- Some footage was captured with enemy dismemberment death effects disabled.

Onimusha: Way of the Sword, an all-new entry in the Onimusha series, plunges the Oni Gauntlet wielding protagonist, Miyamoto Musashi into an early Edo-period Kyoto under siege by monstrous fiends known as Genma. Feel the ring of steel on steel as blades clash in tense back-and-forth duels. Cut down foes with authentic and satisfying swordplay. Awaken Oni Powers to pull off superhuman feats. All these elements combine to deliver an unprecedented swordplay action experience
